text:
morgan: heads up - partner webhook scan flagged a vault payload containing what looks like an old KMS-wrapped blob (transit ciphertext) :eyes:

 sara: :rotating_light: do we know which key/role? can we revoke immediately?

 jamal: I pulled the log. blob references kms_key:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ringA/cryptoKeys/transit-prod-v1 and vault path secret/data/partners/thirdparty

 alex: if it's just ciphertext we can rewrap, but we should assume potential exfil. suggest immediate RBAC lock on vault path and audit enablement for that path.

 morgan: agreed. action plan: 1) restrict read on secret/data/partners/* 2) enable/force audit logging on Vault/KMS for 48h 3) coordinate rewrap + rotate consumer creds 4) notify partner. assigning owners below.

 sara: I'll do RBAC lock. applying a deny role to service accounts that had read access except app-tier-svcacct. will also push a policy change in infra repo. ETA 10m.

 jamal: I will enable audit devices and forward to splunk. command I'm going to run on the Vault leader: 

 ```bash
 vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log log_raw=true
 ```

 jamal: then I'll add the KMS audit sink for rewrap calls. ETA 7m.

 alex: for KMS rewrap, plan: create a new key transit-prod-v2, use KMS rewrap API to re-encrypt ciphertext, update Vault transit-key config to point to v2, then rotate old key to disabled. I'll own the rewrap.

 morgan: partner contact? should we send a heads-up email?

 jamal: partner Slack is patched; @ops-eng to stop any deliveries of historical webhooks. I'll message ops now.

 alex: rewrap steps (short):
 1) create key v2
 2) call: gcloud kms keys versions create --key transit-prod-v2 --location global --keyring ringA
 3) run rewrap on S3 blob store: for blob in $(aws s3 ls s3://partner-logs/ | awk '{print $4}'); do gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=<(aws s3 cp s3://partner-logs/$blob -) --key transit-prod-v1 | gcloud kms encrypt --key transit-prod-v2 | aws s3 cp - s3://partner-logs/$blob; done
 (we'll throttle jobs)

 sara: RBAC lock applied: removed read from team-infra-svcacct and partner-ingest-sa. kept app-tier-svcacct only. PR created: infra/terraform#1227

 morgan: jamal when audit is on, can you grep for any access before T-48h? I want a list of principals that pulled that path.

 jamal: yes. running: 

 ```bash
 grep -E "secret/data/partners/thirdparty" /var/log/vault_audit.log | jq -r '.auth.printable_identity' | sort | uniq -c
 ```

 will post results in 15m.

 alex: rewrap in staging first, then prod. scheduling a canary batch at 2026-03-23T18:30Z. will coordinate with oncall-bot to pause traffic briefly.

 oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-23T18:30Z-18:40Z. notify #release-war-room if you need to extend.

 morgan: communications: I'll draft a short partner note (no PII) and internal incident channel. owners: RBAC: sara, audit+forensics: jamal, rewrap+kms rotation: alex. I'll be incident lead.

 sara: PR merged and applied. I'll standby for rollback instructions if anything breaks. :thumbsup:

 jamal: initial audit grep: 3 principals show up (app-tier-svcacct, legacy-ingest-sa, deploy-bot). legacy-ingest-sa access at T-72h. adding to rotation list.

 alex: starting staging rewrap now. posting updates.

 morgan: thanks team. let's keep messages short in this thread for the runbook. i'll open an incident channel and paste these tasks.

 oncall-bot: incident channel created: #incident-vault-kms-4167777777
